-- options: security_invoker=true
 WITH lines AS (
         SELECT i.recipe_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (m.id IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
                    WHEN (parse_qty(i.quantity) IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
                    WHEN (i.unit = ANY (ARRAY['g'::text, 'ｇ'::text, 'グラム'::text])) THEN parse_qty(i.quantity)
                    WHEN (u.weight_g IS NOT NULL) THEN (parse_qty(i.quantity) * u.weight_g)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS grams,
            ((btrim(COALESCE(i.quantity, ''::text)) = ''::text) OR (i.quantity ~ '^(少々|適量|適宜|ひとつまみ)'::text)) AS negligible,
            m.calorie_per_100g,
            m.protein_g_per_100g,
            m.fat_g_per_100g,
            m.carbohydrate_g_per_100g,
            m.sugar_g_per_100g,
            m.dietary_fiber_g_per_100g,
            m.salt_g_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_a_ug_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_b1_mg_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_b2_mg_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_b6_mg_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_b12_ug_per_100g,
            m.folate_ug_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_c_mg_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_d_ug_per_100g,
            m.vitamin_e_mg_per_100g,
            m.calcium_mg_per_100g,
            m.iron_mg_per_100g,
            m.zinc_mg_per_100g,
            m.potassium_mg_per_100g,
            m.magnesium_mg_per_100g,
            m.price_per_100g
           FROM ((ingredients i
             LEFT JOIN ingredient_master m ON ((m.id = i.ingredient_master_id)))
             LEFT JOIN ingredient_units u ON (((u.ingredient_master_id = m.id) AND (u.unit = i.unit))))
        )
 SELECT r.id AS recipe_id,
    r.servings,
    (count(l.recipe_id))::integer AS ingredient_count,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((l.recipe_id IS NOT NULL) AND (l.grams IS NULL) AND (NOT l.negligible))))::integer AS unresolved_count,
    round((sum(((l.grams / (100)::numeric) * l.calorie_per_100g)) / (NULLIF(r.servings, 0))::numeric), 0) AS calorie_per_serving,
    round((sum(((l.grams / (100)::numeric) * l.protein_g_per_100g)) / (NULLIF(r.servings, 0))::numeric), 2) AS protein_g_per_serving,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_household_member(target_household_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.household_members hm
    where hm.household_id = target_household_id
      and hm.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parse_qty(t text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when t is null then null
    when btrim(t) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' then btrim(t)::numeric
    when btrim(t) ~ '^[0-9]+/[0-9]+$'
      then split_part(btrim(t), '/', 1)::numeric / nullif(split_part(btrim(t), '/', 2)::numeric, 0)
    else null
  end
